findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_article, get_design_template, get_skill · Private data: recommend_skills_for_project · Public sink: recommend_skills_for_project.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_article, get_design_template, get_skill · Private data: recommend_skills_for_project · Public sink: recommend_skills_for_project

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
